Any city guide ({wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC}) can send you on the Pilgrimage of Ashes: a journey through the five holy places of Tibia, where you buy the five {wiki:Blessings|blessings} at a 1000 gold discount each. At the end, if you are below level 25, the guide gives you back 20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
Guide Luke, in Thais (any city guide works)
Premium Account to reach the last holy place (Eremo). Free Accounts can only get four of the five blessings.
You only receive the 20 platinum coins at the end if you are **below level 25**.
Gold for the blessings: each blesser asks for the discounted price (1000 gold in the recorded dialogues)
Money for travel (boats, including the boat to Cormaya and the boatman Pemaret)
optional, to put out the fire around Pydar (needs level 17 and magic level 3)
Health potions to cross the fire to Pydar
The five {wiki:Blessings|blessings} with a 1000 gold discount each (only once)
You have to visit the blessers **in this order**: Norf → Humphrey → Edala → Kawill → Pydar → Eremo. With all of them say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Each NPC marks the next place on your map.

To get to and leave Pydar you have to step on {item:Fire Field|fire}. As it is a protection zone, eating doesn't regenerate health or mana: bring potions or {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes}.

Talk to any city guide ({wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPCs}), for example {npc:Guide Luke} in Thais. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. The guide sends you to the White Flower Temple, south of Thais.

Go **south** of Thais, following the white flowers, to the {wiki:White Flower Temple} ({coord:32346,32364,7}). The monk {npc:Norf} is **1 floor up** inside the temple. Talk to him: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You pay 1000 gold and receive the 1st blessing (*spiritual shielding*).
Go back **north** to Thais and go to the port. Talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the port of **Carlin**, next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}.

From Carlin go **north** to the {wiki:Fields of Glory} and the big stone circle. The druid {npc:Humphrey} is to the right of it, **1 floor up** ({coord:32359,31683,6}). Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
Go back **south** to the port of Carlin and talk to {npc:Captain Greyhound}: {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the port of **Ab'Dendriel**, next to {npc:Captain Seagull}.

Leave through the gates of **Ab'Dendriel** and go **southeast** to an ancient tree: inside is the Suntower, where {npc:Edala} is, way up high ({coord:32698,31718,2}, **5 floors above** the ground). Climb up to her and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. Then go back down the same stairs.
3rd blessing: The Fire of the Suns

{wiki:Kazordoon} is inside the mountain The Big Old One, **south** of Ab'Dendriel, in the middle of the continent ({coord:32614,31923,7}). There are two ways to get there:
1. **On foot** (also for Free Accounts): go south to the mountain entrance (see {wiki:Route: Kazordoon|the route to the Kazordoon entrance}). Bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}: there are rope spots and hidden holes.
2. **{wiki:Steamship}** (Premium): take a boat to **Edron**, then {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to **Cormaya** ({key:cormaya}) and there {npc:Gurbasch} takes you to Kazordoon ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the underground port, next to {npc:Brodrosch}.
The 4th blessing (Spark of the Phoenix) is given by two priests: first earth ({npc:Kawill}), then fire ({npc:Pydar}).
In **Kazordoon**, go down to the earth temple ({coord:32644,31969,12}) and talk to {npc:Kawill}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
Go to the fire temple, nearby ({coord:32655,31893,11}), and talk to {npc:Pydar}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. To leave, cross the fire again the same way.

To reach Pydar (and to leave) you have to walk over {item:Fire Field|fire}. It is a protection zone, so eating doesn't regenerate health or mana. Bring potions or, if you have level 17 and magic level 3, {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes} to put out the fire.
4th blessing: The Spark of the Phoenix

Pydar sends you to **Edron** and from there by boat to **Cormaya** (tell {npc:Captain Seahorse} {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}). Shortcut from Kazordoon: go down to the {wiki:Steamship} at the bottom of the city ({coord:32661,31957,15}) and tell {npc:Brodrosch} {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}; you arrive in Cormaya next to {npc:Gurbasch}. In Cormaya, go to the island's **north port**, where the boatman {npc:Pemaret} is.

In **Cormaya**, go to the **north port** and ask the boatman {npc:Pemaret} for a passage to the hermit's island: {key:hi}, {key:eremo}, {key:yes}. The trip is **free** and takes you to the small {wiki:Eremo's Island}, southeast of Edron.

The island has no boat back: talk to {npc:Eremo} and say {key:hi} and {key:back} ({key:cormaya}, {key:tibia} or {key:teleport} also work) to return to **Cormaya**. From there {npc:Pemaret} takes you to **Edron** ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 20 gp), where there is a city guide and the boat of {npc:Captain Seahorse} to other cities.

Go to **any** city guide and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. If you are **below level 25** you get 20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} (2000 gold) back. From level 25 on, the guide just congratulates you.
The discount only applies once: if you repeat the pilgrimage on your own, you pay the full price of the blessings.
The two Enhanced Blessings, {wiki:Blood of the Mountain} and {wiki:Heart of the Mountain}, are not part of this quest, but you can buy them if you feel ready.
This quest is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.
